subject: Operations
title: AI-Powered Supply Chains
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on AI-Powered Supply Chains.

hook.text: An AI predicted a port closure 10 days before it happened by analyzing weather, shipping data, and news.

buildup.text: AI enhances demand forecasting, route optimization, inventory management, and risk prediction.

discovery.text: Machine learning models process millions of data points and find patterns humans can't see—improving accuracy.

twist.text: AI models need clean, abundant data. Poor data quality leads to confident but wrong recommendations.

climax.text: Companies using AI in supply chains report 15% lower logistics costs and 35% less excess inventory.

punchline.text: AI sees patterns. Humans make decisions. Together: power.

quiz.question: What can AI improve in supply chains?
